verdict.rationale: The story applies because monday.com ships its own agents, and those agents could plausibly consume external MCP servers. However, every MCP mention in the evidence is server-side: monday's hosted MCP URL, the monday MCP, and the developer MCP, which outside agents connect to. Nothing documents registering third-party MCP servers so monday's own agents can use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
